examples.headline: Where Mumbai's Elite Call Home
examples.primary_text: 3 & 4 BHK residences in Worli. Starting ₹8.5 Cr. India's finest address — limited inventory.
examples.why_it_works: Status-led, scarcity trigger, price anchoring at the top of the funnel.

examples.headline: 3 BHK Homes Built for Pune's Future
examples.primary_text: Skyline Heights, Hinjewadi. ₹1.5 Cr onwards. Walk to IT parks, breathe in the hills. EMIs from ~₹95K/mo.
examples.description: Book your site visit this weekend.
examples.why_it_works: Functional benefit (commute), aspirational anchor (hills), concrete EMI hook lowers friction.

examples.on_screen: Drone over Worli skyline. Sunrise. Cut to interior — marble, ocean view, gold accents. End on logo + RERA badge.
examples.voiceover: In a city of fifteen million, only three hundred families will live here. The Crest, Worli. Now accepting expressions of interest.
examples.why_it_works: Numbers create exclusivity, single sensory moment (ocean view), zero salesy CTA — invites private inquiry.

examples.headline: Apna Plot, Lonavala Hills Mein
examples.primary_text: Green Acres — NA-approved 1500-2400 sqft plots starting ₹25L. Clear title, gated layout, 2 hours from Mumbai. WhatsApp for site plan.
examples.why_it_works: Hinglish headline lands with mid-market buyers, addresses trust objections (NA-approved, clear title) before they're asked.

examples.headline: Worli Sea-View 4BHK
examples.primary_text: From ₹8.5 Cr | RERA Approved | Private Viewings
examples.description: Limited inventory in a 12-acre gated estate. Private viewings by appointment.
examples.why_it_works: Search intent buyers want price, RERA, and exclusivity confirmed before clicking — all three in 30 chars each.
